tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search over published MBD Travel tours, experiences, hotels and the Dubai visa (examples: "Japan tour", "Dubai desert safari", "Paris hotel", "Dubai visa"; Turkish works too). Each result carries an id. Currency comes from the currency argument or the query ("dollar", "AED"), else EUR. A h

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text, price and site link for a record id. Id format: <tur|deneyim|otel|vize>:<tr|en>:<EUR|USD|AED>:<key> (tour, experience, hotel, visa); change only the currency part to switch currency. A tour record carries itinerary, inclusions, exclusions, hotels and departures, and names what

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Lists and filters published tours by free text, destination, maximum from-price, departure date range and sort. Prices are "from" prices with their basis, not fixed prices. Returns an empty list with emptyReason when nothing matches. Tours only: no hotels, experiences or visas.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Returns one tour: description, airline, nights, day-by-day itinerary, included and excluded items, hotels, upcoming departure dates and the first departure's price per slot (adult, child). cancellation holds the fixed tour cancellation and refund policy. Fields without data are listed in missing. An

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Returns a tour's departures with the price of every occupancy slot for each (adult, single, extra bed, children, infant). Prices are not trimmed; every occupancy slot is listed. Past departures are excluded. Paged by date: default 12 per page; nextCursor is the cursor of the next page. The dates ret

tools.name: browse_destinations
tools.description: Lists catalogue countries and cities with their published tour counts. scope: countries, cities (of one country) or featured (default: the cities MBD Travel highlights). There is no continent, region or theme grouping. Returns destinations only, not tours.

tools.name: compare_tours
tools.description: Puts two to four tours side by side with the same fields. It returns every field of each tour. It gives no winner, score or verdict; null fields stay null.

tools.name: find_last_minute_tours
tools.description: Returns tours departing soon, soonest first, with dates. Covers last minute, near-term, urgent, right away, this week and tour at airfare price requests. Selection is by departure date only; it is not a discount. windowDays states the length of the window in days. It has no date range or destination

tools.name: list_hotels
tools.description: Lists the curated hotel pool by country, area and stars, with facility tags. No supplier call and no price (a price needs dates and guests). city matches area words ("Antalya", "Business Bay"); the free-text argument matches name words. Each hotel carries a hotelId. tools.name: quote_hotel_stay
tools.description: Gets a live supplier offer or MBD contract price (pricingSource) for hotels and dates. Books nothing and holds no room. An unverified price is not returned. PRICE_ON_REQUEST means no price is on file; the reply then carries pageUrl and contact. Supplier calls are limited daily. Needs check-in, check

tools.name: search_transfers
tools.description: Private transfers, fixed price per vehicle. Dubai: DXB, SHJ, AUH to hotel, city transfer, full-day tour. Istanbul: IST, SAW to hotel, priced by hotel side (pass district or side). tools.name: quote_transfer
tools.description: Prices one transfer for a party from the stored list price: vehicles needed (a 7th passenger needs a second), price per vehicle, total, cheapest option. Reads only: no basket, hold or order. Needs slug, direction and party size (Istanbul also needs district).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
